p1_findings.title: validated file identity is not the file consumed
p1_findings.evidence: validate_bitpack authenticated trusted_root/same.bitpack as all zero, while iter_polyphase_tiles and _unpack_input reopened raw relative same.bitpack under CWD and consumed all ones (mapped_sum 46, source_popcount 8). A controlled same-size replacement after validation also made the consumed SHA differ from the recorded SHA.
p1_findings.impact: CLI or direct relative-path mapping can read unvalidated bytes; a post-validation replacement can also split receipt identity from workload bytes.
p1_findings.repair: Return and consume one validated absolute Path (or preferably one no-follow file descriptor) in every memmap/fromfile/unpack path. Pin resolve identity, hash and data reads to the same opened inode; at minimum rehash the consumed file after mapping and fail on identity drift.

p1_findings.title: trusted-root ancestor symlink bypasses the stated component policy
p1_findings.evidence: _trusted_root lstat checks only the final package directory. trusted_root=/tmp/.../alias_parent/pkg is accepted when alias_parent is a directory symlink.
p1_findings.impact: the lexical trusted package root can be redirected before its final component, contradicting the author contract and request's every-parent-symlink requirement.
p1_findings.repair: Walk from the filesystem anchor through every trusted-root component with lstat and reject symlinks before resolving. State explicitly whether unavoidable system ancestors are permitted, then bind the resolved root identity for every candidate.
